diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~136% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.283), which favours a robust combination.

Series context: trend strength 0.9746 and seasonal strength 0.3954; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.283); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.675.
